name: Paul M. Galovich
occupation: Hot Springs County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Hot Springs County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; lost the August 2026 Republican primary)
background: Paul M. Galovich is a Hot Springs County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election. The Thermopolis Independent Record reported that unofficial 2026 primary results showed Chip Axtell and Phillip Scheel winning the Republican nominations, upsetting the incumbent, and listed Galovich with 358 votes. Incoming commissioner Chip Axtell takes office in January 2027.

sources.name: Thermopolis Independent Record, Aug. 20, 2026, Unofficial primary election results show upset in HSC commissioner race
